Work through these checks in order, and record what you actually observe for each:
1. Open /licences and note the current URL. Then Open Shipping estimate, return with browser Back, then open the purchasify logo and return again. — expect: Shipping estimate must reach /estimate, and the logo must reach /; both returns must restore /licences.
2. At 375px viewport width, open /licences with any plan page visible. Then Inspect the catalogue table and try to reach every Choose control without horizontal page scrolling. — expect: All six column headings and every visible Choose control must be readable and reachable, not clipped.

Test the public licence planner by exercising pagination, remembered team size, plan selection, minimum-seat validation, quote totals, and narrow-screen usability.

Work through these checks in order, and record what you actually observe for each:
1. Open /licences and set seats to 10. Then Select Starter Monthly and read the quote summary. — expect: The summary must show Starter Monthly, 10 seats, and an estimated monthly total of $90.00.
2. Open /licences at a narrow mobile viewport around 375px wide. Then Inspect every table column and operate the pagination and Select controls. — expect: All plan names, values, and controls must be readable and reachable without clipped or hidden table content.
3. Select a qualifying plan, request a quote, and note its confirmation. Then Change the seat count and reread the confirmation and quote summary. — expect: The confirmation must update or clear; it must not continue describing the old seat count.
4. Select the last visible plan on page 1, then navigate to page 2 and page 3. Then Return to page 1 and read the selected row and quote plan. — expect: The selection must survive pagination and the quote must still name the original plan.
5. Select Team Annual and enter 6 seats; note the plan, seats, and estimated monthly amount. Then Click Request quote and read the confirmation message. — expect: Confirmation must name Team Annual, 6 seats, and the selected quote; estimate must be $90.00.
6. Select Business Monthly and enter 19 seats.
